correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the fiber classification. With no fiber over the center, the map is an injection to leaves or has exactly one doubled fiber consisting of the source center and a leaf. A center fiber {0} allows only singleton leaf fibers; a center fiber {j} with j a leaf permits at most one extra fiber, namely {0}; a center fiber {0,j} permits none. These cases give all five terms of R including the empty map. Idempotents fix the image pointwise; if the image contains no center, only the source center can additionally map into the fixed leaf set, while a doubled center fiber gives the extra n rank-one idempotents. For regularity, restrict any generalized inverse to the image to obtain a continuous section, and conversely use such a section for fgf=f. A doubled leaf fiber allows a leaf representative; center-image cases allow an edge-respecting or one-point section. The forced inverse of an injection to leaves fails exactly when it takes two target leaves onto a source edge, equivalently when the domain contains the center and another point. Counting those domains and injections gives B. A separate exhaustive partial-map/section check matched R, E, B and the obstruction in all 25 rank strata for 1 <= n <= 5, including K2, where all nine maps are regular.
